name: xxmi-debug
description: Codex integration for inspecting and controlling a running XXMI/3DMigoto instance through the standalone MCP bridge.

interface.shortDescription: Inspect and control running XXMI Mods
interface.longDescription: Connects Codex to a running XXMI/3DMigoto instance through its local named-pipe bridge for status, logs, frame-analysis review, capture requests, and config or shader reloads.
defaultPrompt: Inspect the running XXMI instance and recent Mod errors.
